item.title: About
item.description:
I am a Green Hydrogen and Energy Policy professional with over 11 years of experience across research, national policy advisory, project execution, and techno-economic analysis.

Currently, I work with Ernst & Young (EY) as part of the Hydrogen Project Management Unit supporting the Ministry of New and Renewable Energy (MNRE), Government of India under the National Green Hydrogen Mission.

My expertise includes hydrogen production, compression, high-pressure storage, hydrogen refuelling stations, policy formulation, financial modelling, and international market analysis
